description.text: The thirteenth set of the EX series, released on 3 May 2006 with 111 cards, 110 numbered and a secret Mew, and two theme decks, FireMist and FloodRush. It takes Delta Species Pokémon deeper into the forest near Holon, with Trainers for them such as Holon Adventurer and Holon Lake, and it has only three Pokémon-ex, the fewest of any EX set. It holds the last Pokémon that can be played as Energy, and its Pokémon Star are Pikachu, Mewtwo and a Delta Species Gyarados.
